name: Vehicle Job History
query:
select
	v.registration_no as "Vehicle:Link/Coach Work Vehicle:130",
	v.make_model as "Make / Model::160",
	cwo.name as "Job:Link/Coach Work Order:150",
	cwo.customer_name as "Customer::180",
	cwo.stage as "Stage:Link/Work Stage:140",
	cwo.posting_date as "Job Date:Date:110",
	cwo.total_amount as "Amount:Currency:120"
from `tabCoach Work Vehicle` v
left join `tabCoach Work Order` cwo on cwo.vehicle = v.name and cwo.docstatus < 2
order by v.registration_no asc, cwo.posting_date desc
